tasks.title: Test and fix slugify boundary whitespace
tasks.instructions: Work only in the assigned AgentBraid worktree. Modify only slug.py and test_slug.py. First add regression tests covering leading whitespace, trailing whitespace, whitespace on both ends, whitespace-only input, and empty input, while preserving the existing lowercasing/internal-space test. Before editing slug.py, run `python3 -m unittest -v`; capture the exact complete nonzero failing output and place it in result.notes, never result.validations. Then make the smallest slug.py change that ignores leading and trailing whitespace before preserving the existing lowercasing and literal-space-to-hyphen behavior. Rerun `python3 -m unittest -v`; it must pass, and record only this final passing command in result.validations. Do not inspect or depend on other task result metadata. Do not access the network or credentials, add dependencies, commit, push, publish, or modify the primary workspace.
acceptance_criteria: Only slug.py and test_slug.py are modified in the assigned worktree.

Before slug.py is changed, test_slug.py is extended with objectively distinct cases for leading and trailing whitespace, whitespace-only input, and empty input while retaining coverage of lowercasing and internal-space replacement.

Running `python3 -m unittest -v` after the test additions and before the implementation change exits nonzero; its exact complete failing output is recorded in result.notes and is not included in result.validations.
slug.py implements the minimal behavior change so boundary whitespace is ignored before `lower()` and replacement of internal literal spaces with hyphens.
After the fix, `python3 -m unittest -v` exits zero and all tests pass; only this final passing command is recorded in result.validations.
No dependencies are added, and no network, credentials, commit, push, publication, or primary-workspace mutation is performed.
required_capabilities: read and edit files in the assigned worktree
capture command output separately in task notes and validations

final_acceptance_criteria: The final lead review confirms the diff changes only slug.py and test_slug.py.
The final lead review confirms test_slug.py covers leading/trailing whitespace, whitespace-only input, empty input, and preserves the existing lowercasing/internal-space behavior.
The final lead review independently runs `python3 -m unittest -v` and it exits successfully with all tests passing.

The implementation task's result.notes contains the exact failing `python3 -m unittest -v` output captured after adding regression tests and before changing slug.py; no failing command appears in result.validations.
No commit, push, publication, network access, credential access, or primary-workspace modification occurs.
